model_output.verdict: A staff engineer with substantial payments architecture work, but few measures of its reach or results.
write_up: A recruiter sees a staff engineer leading payments infrastructure work, with earlier experience in fraud and object storage. The main question is how far the ledger redesign reached and what changed after it shipped.
The fraud pipeline line is a good model: it names the system, its tools and a latency measure. Bring some of that detail to the staff role, especially the team lead work and the ledger redesign.

cards.line: - Technical lead for the ledger and settlement platform team
cards.cannot_tell: The platform is named, but the team and your leadership work aren't. A recruiter will want to know how many engineers were involved and what you led.
cards.example: Technical lead for the ledger and settlement platform team of [number] engineers, responsible for [leadership responsibilities]
cards.question: How many engineers were on the team, and what were your responsibilities as technical lead?

cards.line: - Led the redesign of the core ledger service from a monolithic Postgres-backed system to a horizontally scalable event-sourced architecture on Kafka and CockroachDB
cards.cannot_tell: The architecture change is concrete. What isn't here is what the redesign changed for the ledger or the people using it.
cards.example: Led the redesign of the core ledger service from a monolithic Postgres-backed system to a horizontally scalable event-sourced architecture on Kafka and CockroachDB, resulting in [what changed]
cards.question: What changed after the ledger redesign, and how was it measured?

cards.line: - Built the real-time fraud scoring pipeline (Flink, Kafka) processing payment events with p99 latency under 50ms
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It connects your own work to a concrete performance measure without making the reader guess what the pipeline handled.

cards.line: - Reduced reconciliation break rate and manual ops effort
cards.cannot_tell: Two useful improvements are named, but a recruiter can't tell how much either changed.
cards.example: Reduced reconciliation break rate by [change in break rate] and manual ops effort by [change in ops effort]
cards.question: How did the reconciliation break rate and manual ops effort change?

cards.line: - Improved API latency and availability through caching and request coalescing
cards.cannot_tell: The methods are clear, but the improvements have no measure attached. What changed for latency and availability?
cards.example: Improved API latency by [change in latency] and availability by [change in availability] through caching and request coalescing
cards.question: How did API latency and availability change after the caching and request coalescing work?

cards.line: - Contributed to the migration of the control plane to Kubernetes
cards.cannot_tell: The migration is named, but your part in it isn't. Keep the contribution at its actual level and say which piece was yours.
cards.example: Contributed to the migration of the control plane to Kubernetes by [your contribution]
cards.question: What part of the control plane migration did you work on?

fit.note: Your experience points toward payments infrastructure and distributed systems roles. The architecture work and technical leadership are clear; measures of the ledger redesign and team leadership would help establish their reach.
